summary: Iteration 2 (VIDEO + STRIPE payments) end-to-end validation. Backend: 10/10 pytest passing — admin login, register (30 free credits), tour video (12 créditos, ffmpeg genera mp4 servido como video/mp4 via /api/files/{path}?token=), reel video (8 créditos, 9:16), créditos insuficientes -> 402 con detalle en español, listado de videos, GET /api/payments/packages (3 paquetes credits_100/300/1000), POST /api/payments/checkout devuelve checkout_url en checkout.stripe.com y session_id, GET /api/payments/status/{id} devuelve estado, checkout rechaza paquete inválido (400) y sin auth (401). Frontend: login admin, credit-counter (448 créditos), diálogo Comprar créditos con package-credits_100/300/1000 visibles, buy-credits_300 redirige correctamente a checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_..., diálogo Generar video con video-format-tour / video-format-reel / video-music-toggle / video-agency-input / video-confirm todos presentes, tras confirmar reel los créditos bajan de 448 a 440 (=8) y aparece videos-section con tarjeta 'Generando video…' + tarjeta previa con <video> reproducible y botón de descarga.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:_process_video — Uses tempfile.mkdtemp() with a manual shutil.rmtree in finally; safe, but generate_video already uses its own TemporaryDirectory. Consider using `with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()` for extra safety.
server.py: /api/files serves images (fetching by user_id) OR videos, but performs two separate DB queries. Consider a single scoped lookup or role-based bypass for admin.
server.py:721 startup uses deprecated @app.on_event; migrate to lifespan handler (FastAPI 0.109+).

video.py:_esc strips ':' and quotes which mangles addresses like 'Calle Mayor 3, Madrid' — acceptable for safety, but consider whitelisted escaping via drawtext textfile=@ to avoid dropping colons in agency/subtitle.

payments.py:grant_credits — idempotency looks correct (credited flag + conditional update). Consider adding an index on payment_transactions.session_id for perf and unique index to prevent dup inserts under race.
server.py: cookie login sets samesite='none'; secure=True but CORS `allow_origins` uses FRONTEND_URL env; ensure preview URL matches to avoid credential drop.
PropertyView.jsx:loadVideos re-schedules polling with setTimeout(loadVideos,4000) but does not clear the timer on unmount — can call setState on unmounted component.
test_credentials: Admin admin@watchful.app / Watchful2026! (seeded, tenía 448 créditos residuales en este env). Users creados dinámicamente con prefijo test_reg_/TEST_.
seed_data_creation: Fixture crea propiedad TEST_VideoProp con 3 fotos PNG 1x1 y la borra al finalizar; usuarios TEST_ registrados no se limpian automáticamente.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest depende de env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (no default). Ejecutar con: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest backend/tests/test_video_payments.py -v`. La generación ffmpeg tour(1080p) tarda ~15-25s y reel(1080x1920) ~10-15s con 3 fotos; usar timeouts ≥120s. Pago Stripe end-to-end (tarjeta 4242) NO fue completado en este run — sólo verificado el redirect a checkout.stripe.com; el flujo /payment/success + polling y suma de créditos no fue ejecutado con pago real (recomendado test manual o script Stripe test-clock).
